emphasis_points: Highlight elevated counter and island seating ergonomics: circular or bar-style footrest placement, supportive backrest contours, and seat height relative to standard kitchen islands (counter height) or high counters (bar height).
Describe bar cabinet specialized storage: stemware hanging racks, horizontal wine bottle cubbies, and prep surface drop-down leaves.
Emphasize sturdy base stability (splayed wooden legs, weighted circular iron pedestals) and compact vertical footprint.
avoid_list: Do not confuse counter-height seating (60-65 cm seat height) with standard bar-height seating (75 cm seat height).
Do not assume 360-degree swivel or pneumatic gas-lift height adjustability unless confirmed in specifications.
Do not use superficial party/club clichés; focus on refined entertaining, breakfast-counter utility, and craftsmanship.
tone_notes: Sleek, social, and compact, balancing casual entertaining, breakfast counter utility, and stable vertical poise.
